title: Deva Mace
summary: A mace wielded by Devas. Hits deal 1d6 Bludgeoning plus 4d8 Radiant.

fields.Availability: The item is not normally sold or looted. The pinned item describes a PC inventory workaround on Patch 8/Hotfix 31.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
